params.prompt: Professional game-art reference sheet: plain light warm-gray background, even neutral studio lighting, every item isolated and fully visible with a soft contact shadow, consistent scale across items, generous spacing, clean grid layout. At the far left stands a flat gray silhouette of the chibi student, three heads tall, as a scale reference. Title: "Recolectables · v1". Twelve collectible objects found while exploring, each lying on a small round patch of grass or dirt with a faint cyan sparkle above it that marks it as collectible. Top row: "COL-01 Antena parabólica" a rusty fallen satellite dish; "COL-02 Panel solar" a cracked old solar panel; "COL-03 Placa de circuito" a green printed circuit board; "COL-04 Radio antigua" a transistor radio; "COL-05 Motor" a small electric motor; "COL-06 Cable de cobre" a coil of copper wire. Bottom row: "COL-07 Batería" a battery pack; "COL-08 Antena de varilla" a telescopic rod antenna; "COL-09 Muestra de agua" a capped sample vial with brown estuary water; "COL-10 Vaina de ceibo" a ceiba seed pod bursting with white cotton; "COL-11 Muestra de roca" a rock sample with a shiny mineral vein; "COL-12 Carta estelar" a folded star chart page. Under each item, a small neat hand-lettered label in Spanish exactly as written above, and a short title at the top left. No other text, no logos, no watermarks. Art style: stylized low-poly 3D exactly like the reference images, crisp faceted flat-shaded planes with a hand-painted gradient on each facet, cel-shaded lighting with a bright rim light, chunky simplified forms, clean readable silhouettes, matte materials, palette of cream, terracotta, tropical green, petrol blue and warm wood browns, with cyan reserved for technology, data and collectibles.
